caption.purpose: Hints, messages, status, badges, column heads; 14px on phones.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one save action in each section footer.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.52 0.19 268); color: oklch(0.99 0.004 268); font: 600 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.46 0.18 268); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.19 268); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Upload, Disconnect and other non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.64 0.02 265); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.995 0.002 265); color: oklch(0.22 0.03 265); font: 600 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.982 0.003 265); border-color: oklch(0.535 0.03 265); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.19 268); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.06 25); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.995 0.002 265); color: oklch(0.5 0.18 27); font: 600 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0.015 25); border-color: oklch(0.55 0.2 29); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.19 268); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: All text, email and password fields.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 280px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.64 0.02 265); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.995 0.002 265); color: oklch(0.22 0.03 265); font: 400 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.535 0.03 265); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.52 0.19 268); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.52 0.19 268 / 0.3); }

components.name: Toggle
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; display: inline-flex; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-toggle span { width: 38px; height: 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.64 0.02 265); position: relative; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-toggle span::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.99 0.004 268); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.22 0.03 265 / 0.25); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-toggle input:checked + span { background: oklch(0.52 0.19 268); } .ds-toggle input:checked + span::after { transform: translateX(16px); } .ds-toggle input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.19 268); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Nav
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 220px; font: 500 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: oklch(0.44 0.03 265); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-nav a:hover { background: oklch(0.982 0.003 265); color: oklch(0.22 0.03 265); } .ds-nav a.is-active { background: oklch(0.955 0.025 268); color: oklch(0.22 0.03 265); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.52 0.19 268); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Connected Badge
components.description: Connection status beside a provider name.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 8px; line-height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.965 0.03 155); color: oklch(0.5 0.12 155); font: 500 13px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

narrative.overview: Northwind's settings are a control panel a person visits for one errand and leaves. The system is a cool neutral field tinted toward the accent hue, with a single indigo accent reserved for actions, selection and focus.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, used for primary actions, current selection, focus and "on" toggles only.
Each settings section is one form with its own footer and one save action.
Validation, saving and connection states are explicit, consistent and never colour-only.
Flat at rest: panels are hairline-bordered, only floating layers cast shadows.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears only where the user can act or where something is selected or focused. It is never decoration.

rules.name: The 3:1 Edge Rule
rules.body: Anything the user types into or toggles has an edge of at least 3:1 against its background. Hairlines are for grouping, not for controls.

rules.name: The No Shouting Rule
rules.body: No uppercase tracked overlines. Column heads and the sidebar heading are sentence-case captions.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: If it does not float, it does not cast a shadow.

dos: Do keep indigo for actions, selection and focus only.
Do give every section exactly one primary save action in its footer.
Do show unsaved, saving, saved and invalid states in the footer status and at the field, never by colour alone.
Do keep control edges at 3:1 or better and text at 4.5:1 or better in both themes.
Do use the token scales; no raw hex, no off-scale spacing.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS admin template: every block a shadowed card, gradients on avatars, glassy headers, badges and pills everywhere.
Don't add strangeness without purpose: over-decorated buttons, mismatched form controls, gratuitous motion, invented affordances for standard tasks.
Don't leave it unclear which save button covers which fields, or whether anything saved.
Don't nest boxes inside panels (logo tiles, ringed avatars, boxed sidebar widgets).
Don't use a side-stripe border as an accent on any panel or alert.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels or weights outside 400/500/600.
